Replies in the chat count from this version on. Tap one to see its translation.
A reply needed its translation when the translation stayed on screen for at least 2.5 seconds. A tap and a quick tap back doesn\'t count.
Time counts only while the chat and the reply are on screen. Each reply counts once, however often you tap it.
Only replies you answered count, from this version on. Older replies can\'t be measured.
The percentage shows from 10 replies. The trend compares the last 4 weeks with the 4 before, each with at least 20 replies.
Deleting a conversation deletes what was counted for its replies. So does editing a sent message, for the replies it removes.
